main_text.p: ne neglectum, arcem in insula nobilissi-ma & antiquissima urbis parte, magni-ficentissimo opere structam, sedem tyrannorum & contra omnia eorundem monumenta, funditus evertit, excepta sola Gelonis statua, cujus memoria, populo erat gratissima propter benevolentiam ejus multis modis spectatam. Tum urbem bellis & tumultibus superioribus evastatam, & cædibus fugaque civium exhaustam ædificiis rursum ornare, & habitatorum frequentia excolere cœpit. In hunc finem exules Syracusanos ex Sicilia, Græcia, Asia revocatos restituit in integrum, quos ad decem hominum millia fuisse perhibent: atque multò majorem numerum ex Siculis & vicinis Italis Græci generis dicitur addidisse. Ita solitudo urbis brevi tempore in abundantiam populi commutata fuit. Deinde armis superatos reliquos Siciliæ tyrannos evertit, Pœnos summis viribus ad occupandam & subjiciendam sibi totam insulam connixos ex insula decedere coëgit, urbes desolatas instauravit, libertati locum ubique fecit. Denique Siciliam, in quam miserrimè afflictam venerat, studio ac felici virtute sua cultissimam reddidit, & posthabito reditu in patriam, istic quod reliquum longævæ vitæ exegit, omni-

page.notes: The first word of the page is "ne", a fragment of "neglectum" from the previous page, so the paragraph is marked cont="true". "omni-" ends the page with a hyphen and continues on the next page. Long s was normalised to s throughout. The "ct" ligature in "neglectum" was written out. Show-through and stains at the lower left and left edge were left out. A small mark at the right edge beside the third line is a scan artefact, not a note.
